{"content": "# Q1 2026 Effort Report: p-limit

**Contributor:** Elif Demir
**Period:** 1 January – 31 March 2026 (Europe/Istanbul, UTC+3)

## Summary

| Measure | Q1 2026 |
|---|---|
| Commits authored | **5** |
| Active working time with Claude Code | **about 5.9 hours** (356 minutes) |

## How these were counted

- **Commits:** commits on the p-limit repository authored by Elif Demir, dated within the quarter in Istanbul time. Automated dependency-bot commits are excluded. A commit made at 01:30 on 1 April (Istanbul) falls in Q2 and is not counted.
- **Active time:** taken from the timestamps of exported Claude Code sessions on the p-limit project. Any gap longer than 30 minutes between consecutive activity is treated as a break and not counted. Sessions that ran at the same time are merged so overlapping time is counted once. Time after midnight on 31 March (Istanbul) is cut off at the end of the quarter.
- **Left out:** a session on a different (non-p-limit) project, a session dated in April, and a duplicate copy of one exported session.

## Caveats

- Active time only covers work done in Claude Code sessions. Work done outside them (reading, thinking, coding in an editor) is not included, so it understates total effort.
- The 30-minute rule is a fixed cut-off, so short pauses are counted as work and longer ones are not.

This report contains counts only: no code, prompts or session content.
